name: Acceptor Transaction Log Report Response V 06
definition: This AcceptorTransactionLogReportResponse message is sent by an Acquirer or its IntermediaryAgent to provide the report previously expected by a POI.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

ReportResponse.name: Report Response
ReportResponse.definition: Information related to the response of a report request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
